mapper.select: SELECT EXTERNAL_API_ID, API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, RETRY_ENABLED, MAX_RETRY_COUNT, RETRY_INTERVAL_SEC, AUTH_TYPE, AUTH_LOCATION, AUTH_KEY, AUTH_VALUE, AUTH_USERNAME, AUTH_PASSWORD, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API ORDER BY EXTERNAL_API_ID DESC

SELECT EXTERNAL_API_ID, API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, RETRY_ENABLED, MAX_RETRY_COUNT, RETRY_INTERVAL_SEC, AUTH_TYPE, AUTH_LOCATION, AUTH_KEY, AUTH_VALUE, AUTH_USERNAME, AUTH_PASSWORD, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId}

SELECT PARAM_ID, EXTERNAL_API_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, VALUE_TYPE, PARAM_VALUE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, DESCRIPTION FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_PARAM WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, PARAM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API ( API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, RETRY_ENABLED, MAX_RETRY_COUNT, RETRY_INTERVAL_SEC, AUTH_TYPE, AUTH_LOCATION, AUTH_KEY, AUTH_VALUE, AUTH_USERNAME, AUTH_PASSWORD, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{apiName}, #{apiUrl}, #{httpMethod}, #{enabled}, #{retryEnabled}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{retryIntervalSec}, #{authType}, #{authLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authUsername, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authPassword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_PARAM ( EXTERNAL_API_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, VALUE_TYPE, PARAM_VALUE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{externalApiId}, #{paramLocation}, #{paramName}, #{valueType}, #{paramValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valueFormat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requiredYn}, #{sortOrder}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_EXTERNAL_API SET API_NAME = #{apiName}, API_URL = #{apiUrl}, HTTP_METHOD = #{httpMethod}, ENABLED = #{enabled}, RETRY_ENABLED = #{retryEnabled}, MAX_RETRY_COUNT = #{maxRetryCount}, RETRY_INTERVAL_SEC = #{retryIntervalSec}, AUTH_TYPE = #{authType}, AUTH_LOCATION = #{authLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AUTH_KEY = #{authKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AUTH_VALUE = #{authValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AUTH_USERNAME = #{authUsername, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AUTH_PASSWORD = #{authPassword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId}
